about: Lists of local providers for Cedar City, Utah and Iron County (Enoch, Parowan reachable), found 6 October 2026 under brief-lists-only-20261003. Lists only: no provider names recorded as resources, no office-fit rules, no provider pages checked. Statewide Utah lists (211 Utah DHHS directory pages, Utah Legal Services, DLD, vitalrecords, jobs.utah.gov fee waiver, Commerce telecom assistance, veterans.utah.gov, mihp maternal guide, utcourts legal clinics, Lifeline) are already in ogden.json (statewide, see ogden.json) and are not repeated here. St. George (Washington County, about 50 minutes away) is in st-george.json; the 211 Five County guides and the Timpanogos 5th District list appear in both files because they cover both counties. Iron County has no 211 county list of its own: 211 Utah folds it into the Five County guide. Its only county-specific, regularly updated list is the Southwest Utah Public Health Department's Iron County Community Health Resources (October 2025, English and Spanish). Looked at and rejected: the Sixth District Community Resource Guide (utcourts.gov, 2013), which covers Garfield, Kane, Piute, Sanpete, Sevier and Wayne and not Iron; an 'Iron County resources' PDF at mineralarea.edu, which is Missouri; wislawhelp.org and co.iron.wi.gov, Wisconsin; SUU's 2018 'Resource Guide for Living in Cedar City', which is shops and restaurants, not services. Not found as lists: Cedar City Corporation (no resource page found), Iron County government beyond the senior centres and the Sheriff's page, an Iron County homeless coordinating council list (the council exists, chaired from the Cedar City Council with Care and Share as co-chair, but no published provider list found), a United Way list beyond 211, Five County Association of Governments (its site has program pages but no directory). Provider pages (Care and Share, Canyon Creek, 211 provider pages) were not recorded.

gaps.addiction: No Iron County list of its own beyond the Southwest Utah Public Health list's Substance Abuse block (about 7) and a Southwest section in the statewide mihp SUD list. Five County 2021 and the 5th District list are older or thin. Residential treatment is mostly in St. George.
gaps.children-pregnancy: Southwest Public Health list (Children/Youth about 9) and Five County 2025 (about 5). No Iron County pregnancy-specific list; no separate WIC or diapers list for Iron. See statewide mihp guide in ogden.json.
gaps.clothing-household: Only the Southwest Public Health list (Clothing block, about 8). No other Iron County clothing list; aggregators name thrift stores only inconsistently. Plentiful and others have nothing for household goods.
gaps.disability: Southwest Public Health list (about 4) and Five County 2025 (about 3). No Iron County disability directory. Utah Parent Center has only Weber/Davis guides in ogden.json, none for Iron.
gaps.domestic-violence: Thin and all one provider: every list names Canyon Creek Services; DomesticShelters.org has 1 program. The Sheriff's page and the 5th District list add hotlines and Iron County Victim Services. No independent county DV list.
gaps.education: Southwest Public Health list (Education, about 8) only. Iron County School District's own family resources pages (Mental Health, 211) did not load, so no school-district list was read. Adult education: statewide directory in ogden.json.
gaps.employment: Southwest Public Health list (about 5), Five County 2025 (about 3), 5th District (3). No Iron County employment list of its own; the DWS Cedar City office is the real list, and the statewide DWS pages are in ogden.json.
gaps.financial-assistance: No dedicated list. Rent and deposit help appears as a few entries in Five County 2025, the 5th District list and SUU's basic needs page. No Iron County 'help paying bills' page found (needhelppayingbills.com returned 403 for Iron County).
gaps.reentry-support: No list found for Iron County. Searches returned only the Adult Probation and Parole office in Cedar City and a one-name reentry organisation. The statewide reentry lists are in ogden.json (211 Ex-Offender Reentry Programs, probationinfo.org, helpforfelons); Iron County Jail has no reentry page found.
gaps.food: Best covered: Iron County School District food page (about 7), Southwest Public Health (about 8), Plentiful (8), Feeding America (9), Five County and 5th District lists, SUU pages. These overlap heavily: the same few providers (Care and Share, True Life Center, mobile pantry, LDS storehouse). Utah Food Bank's pantry locator seen only in a search result.
gaps.medical-dental-vision: Southwest Public Health list (about 12) and FreeClinics.us (5, verified May 2026). No Iron County dental or vision list; no free-clinic list from the county itself.
gaps.homeless-services: No Iron County homeless list of its own and no published list from the local homeless council. Care and Share is the shelter and appears in every list; Five County 2025 centres on Switchpoint in St. George. homelessshelterdirectory.org refused the fetch (406).
gaps.housing: Housing Authority and Community Action appear in the Southwest Public Health list (about 4), Five County lists and the 5th District list. No Iron County affordable-housing list; no list from Cedar City Corporation found. AffordableHousingOnline-type aggregators for Iron County not searched.
gaps.id-recovery: No Iron County list. The 211 provider pages for Care and Share and Community Action say they pay birth certificate and licence fees, but those are provider pages, not recorded. Statewide birth certificate and ID pages are in ogden.json.
gaps.immigration: No Iron County or Southwest Utah list found. A search returned only Salt Lake and Utah County providers and the statewide Utah Immigration Collaborative; the St. George file has it. Southwest Public Health's Spanish edition is a translation, not an immigration list.
gaps.legal: Thin: 1-2 entries in the Southwest Public Health list and 2-3 in Five County 2025. The only local fact found is a Utah Legal Services pro se clinic at the Fifth District Courthouse in Cedar City (from a search result, not a list); statewide lists are in ogden.json. No Iron County bar or legal-aid list.
gaps.mental-health: Southwest Public Health list (about 6), the Sheriff's page (about 8), SUU health page (about 6), Five County 2021. Mostly the same few providers (Southwest Behavioral Health, Family Healthcare). The district's Mental Health Resources page did not load. No county mental-health directory like Cache County's.
gaps.seniors: Iron County's senior centre page (2 centres), Five County Area Agency on Aging (program pages, no provider directory), Southwest Public Health (about 6), Five County 2025 (about 3). No county senior resource guide; the Area Agency on Aging site offers no Iron County list.
gaps.transportation: Thin: Southwest Public Health list only (about 5: CATS, gas vouchers, taxis, bus to Salt Lake). No Cedar City or Iron County transportation list; CATS is the only public transit. Statewide Medicaid transportation is in st-george.json.
gaps.utilities-phone-internet: Southwest Public Health (about 5), Five County 2025 (about 4), Five County 2021, 5th District (weatherization). The Emergency Broadband Benefit in the Southwest list has ended. No Iron County list otherwise; statewide telecom and HEAT pages are in ogden.json.
gaps.veterans: Thin: Southwest Public Health (about 2), Warriors Fund (4), the Sheriff's page (crisis line). A county veterans service office exists in Parowan (from a search result), but no county veterans list was found. Statewide veterans.utah.gov is in ogden.json.
